scenes.hook: How does code become a web page? Meet H T M L.
scenes.meaning: H T M L means Hypertext Markup Language. It gives web content structure and meaning.
scenes.anatomy: Most elements wrap content in an opening tag and a closing tag. The slash marks the end.
scenes.content: H one marks a main heading. P marks a paragraph. The browser displays your content, without the tags.
scenes.links: An A element creates a link. Its H ref attribute tells the browser where that link goes.
scenes.layers: H T M L structures content. C S S controls appearance. JavaScript adds interactivity.
scenes.practice: Write a heading and paragraph. Save as index dot H T M L. Open it in your browser.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
